name: Marcos "h3xduck" Bajo
biography: Marcos Bajo aka h3xduck is a security researcher and PhD student at the CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security in Germany. His research focuses on exploitation techniques and malware, but more broadly, he's interested in breaking things others build—and building things to break things.
